faq.a: Aftab is associated with Persian. Variant romanization of آفتاب.
No — the underlying form is Persian, not Arabic.
Aftab can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Persian-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.q: What does Aftab mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Aftab is rendered آفتاب and carries the sense سورج، دھوپ.

faq.q: What does Aftab mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Aftab is rendered آفتاب and carries the sense خورشید، آفتاب.
A romanized syllable approximation is af-tab. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Aftab?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Aftab, aftab. Script forms are آفتاب, आफ़ताब.

faq.q: Is Aftab a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
